description.narrative:
Strengthening the technical capacity of the Guatemalan Ombudsman Office for conducting their constitutional mandate of protection of human rigths, trough technical assistance for strengthening the operations in four key areas of the institution.
By the end of the intervention is expected that PDH has increase their response capabilities through an updated human rights case management system; strengthened institutional capacities in comprehensive attention of cases of vulnerable victim communities with gender focus and inclusive language; Strengthen PDH supervision and comprehensive attention capacities based on international human rights standards, cultural and gender perspectives in forced displacement cases; and strong procurement and human rights promotion processes within the PDH through strategic litigation for human rights defenders, journalists, torture and environment related cases.

The Attorney General's Office in Guatemala (MP) is responsible for crime prosecution and criminal investigation. Since 2009 MP has made important advances in the combat of impunity, for cases related to human rights violations committed during the internal armed conflict, and in the identification and deactivation of organized crime structures that are operating in the present.
This contribution is aimed to strengthening the capacities of MP through the Technical Assistance and Capacity Buidling provided by Justice and Education Society (JES) a Canadian Non-Profit Organization specialized in Criminal Prosecution, with an extensive experience in the Northern Triangle of Central America, and ten years of specific experience with the Attorney General Office in Guatemala.
JES has worked with MP to design a comprehensive series of initiatives that will help to fulfill MP´s Strategic Plan by strengthening operations in areas such as human rights, gender based violence, environment and access to justice for excluded and vulnerable groups, such as indigenous people and members of the LGBTI community.
The program is well in line with Swedens strategy for development cooperation with Guatemala 2016-2020 and complements the Swedish support to the International Commission Against Impunity and Corruption (CICIG) as well as Sweden's support to transitional justice.
The program will be directly managed by JES by MP will be at the centre of follow-up and dialogue. The need to counteract criminalization of human rights defenders will receive special attention in the dialogue with MP.

Åklagarmyndigheten i Guatemala (MP, förkortat på spanska) är ansvarig för straffrättsliga åtal och brottsutredning. MP har sedan 2009 gjort viktiga framsteg i kampen mot straffrihet i fall som rör brott mot de mänskliga rättigheterna begångna under den interna väpnade konflikten och i fall som rör identifiering och nedmontering av korrupta nätverk inom staten.
Denna insats syftar till att stärka kapaciteten hos MP genom teknisk assistans och kapacitetsutveckling, som tillhandahålls av justitie-och utbildningssamfundet (JES), en kanadensisk ideell organisation som är specialiserad på straffrättsliga utredningar, med omfattande erfarenhet från Centralamerika och tio års specialiserad erfarenhet av att stödja åklagarmyndigheten i Guatemala.
Insatsen stödjer genomförandet av MP: s strategiska plan genom att förstärka verksamheten inom områden såsom mänskliga rättigheter, våld mot kvinnor, miljö och tillgång till MP för exkluderade grupper, inklusive urfolk och LGBTI-personer. Totalt prioriterar insatsen 18 avdelningar inom MP. De svenska pengarna kommer att kanaliseras till JES, som kommer att tillhandahålla tekniskt stöd, utbildning, metoder för analys av kriminiella nätverk och även köpa in viss utrustning för MPs räkning. Insatsen förväntas leda till en mer kompetent och inkluderande Åklagarmyndighet och därmed ökad tillgång till rättvisa för utsatta grupper.
Insatsen ligger väl i linje med Sveriges samarbetsstrategi för Guatemala 2016-2020 och kompletterar det svenska stödet till den Internationella Kommissionen mot Straffrihet och Korruption, CICIG, och stödet för rättvisa, sanning, gottgörelse och icke-upprepning av de brott mot mänskliga rättigheter som begåtts under den interna väpnade konflikten i Guatemala.
Även om denna insats direkt hanteras av JES, så kommer MP att stå i centrum för dialog och uppföljning. En särskild fråga som Sida ska driva i dialogen med MP är vikten av att aktivt motverka kriminalisering av människorättsförsvarare.

A key element in this contribution is the design and implementation of a Digital Case Management System, which will improve the Ombudsman Office capacity to respond to human rights complaints and requests, also improving the quality of the services provided to their users. In 2022, the PDH publicly released the Case Management System called Complaints and Actions Management System (SGDA for the acronym in Spanish). SGDA is focused on digitalizing and automating internal procedures for monitoring the denounces of human rights violations and enabling mechanisms for the supervision of these procedures
The SGDA system is an innovative digital transformation tool, which is the result of a process of elaboration and updating of the internal manuals and protocols of PDH, defining uniform institutional routes for monitoring cases of Human Rights violations, incorporating the international human rights standards. This system is designed to guarantee greater efficiency and effectiveness in PDH procedures. This system will also guarantee uniformity in the attention given to users of the Ombudsman Office in all the agencies of the institution in Guatemala. At least over 200 personnel across the country were trained on the new system to ensure sustainability.
